    Heading requirements


    • Level 1 heading is the title of the document and can only be used once at the top of the document.
    • Level 2 heading is the subtitle of the document.
    • Headings must begin from h2 or h2 after a h1 heading.
    • Only h2 h3 and h4 headings are listed in the table of contents.
